title: Software Development Methods
description: Systematic methods for designing, coding, testing and documenting medium-sized programs. Tools and techniques to promote programming productivity and software quality. Specifications, code review, testing and debugging methods and tools, version control, file system navigation, object-oriented languages, user interface prototyping, software tools, environments and the fundamentals of software configuration management.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SENG 265, CSC 265.
